patch.title: Olyphant Triboro Plans: DeNaples Proposal Withdrawn, ERCOR Proposal Separate
patch.description: A June 10, 2026 report says Triboro Commerce Park withdrew its seven-building plan. A separate ERCOR Triboro proposal sought nine data centers on a 500-acre property.
patch.longFormSummary: Olyphant’s engineer confirmed withdrawal of Triboro Commerce Park’s seven-building plan. ERCOR Triboro, a Sansone Group company, separately proposed nine data centers, occupying about 100 acres of its 500-acre property. The zoning settlement did not approve a campus.
patch.dateConfidenceReasoning: The date is the cited report or decision milestone, not a verified construction completion or opening day.
